Hi Jordan / Samir,

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about FinTechCo's fraud detection use case and traffic profile. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Discovery notes: primary workload is real-time scoring for transaction streams (~300 TPS peak, 50 TPS baseline).
- Key success metrics you mentioned: sub-100ms p95 latency, cost target < $0.0005/token equivalent, and predictable throughput during peak windows.
- Attachments: I’ve attached a proposed Mutual Action Plan (FinTechCo-MAP-v1.pdf) and a short Redwood serving overview deck.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive (30–45m) with our SE to validate latency/cost assumptions and confirm integration approach.
2) Short pilot (60–90 days) focused on a proof-of-value pipeline and SLO monitoring.
3) Procurement/terms discussion (if pilot looks good).

Can you share availability next week for a technical deep-dive? Options I have: Tue 11/16 10–11am PT, Wed 11/17 2–3pm PT, or Thu 11/18 9–10am PT. If none of these work, tell me a couple of times that do.

Thanks again — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — I can join the next call. High-level technical points to lead with: 

1) Latency & throughput: we can hit sub-100ms p95 for typical scoring models with dedicated GPUs and optimized batching; at 300 TPS peak we recommend sharding across 2-3 GPUs to keep headroom for spikes.
2) Cost controls: show them quantization and batching options — suggest an initial quantized variant for the pilot to cut token inference cost by ~30–50% while validating quality.
3) Integration: we’ll offer a lightweight ingestion pipeline (Kafka webhook) and a sample connector for their ML infra; provide an SLO dashboard (token-level cost + latency tracing) during the pilot.

If you want, I’ll prepare a 1-slide tech summary and join the customer call. I’m available Tue 11/16 10–11am PT and Wed 11/17 after 1pm PT.

—Dylan

- CS deliverables: onboarding plan + weekly check-ins for first 30 days, automated SLO dashboards, knowledge transfer for their infra team.
